cards.questionText:
refer to the following e-mails and schedule.
To: All Valley Realty Employees
From: William Monahan
Date: September 18
Subject: Upcoming software training
Attachment: training.docx
Dear Valley Realty Employees,
Please be aware that employees will be required to complete mandatory software training in the first half of October. There are two programs that will be covered by the training. Investiprop-7 must be installed on all company computers, and we will start using it for all property searches instead of the EstateMax program. It is much more user-friendly, and there are more options for adding specific search criteria. All employees must complete the training, but they can select the date. The other program is Slate Books Pro, which is billing software. The program has recently undergone several upgrades. Only accountants need to take the Slate Books Pro training, and it will be provided on-site in our conference room.
Thanks,
William Monahan
Office Manager, Valley Realty

============================================

Valley Realty Training Schedule

Date Software Program Format Number of Modules Time
October 2 Investiprop-7 Online 6 10:30 A.M.-12:30 P.M.
October 5 Slate Books Pro On-site workshop 4 2:00 P.M.-4:00 P.M.
October 6 Investiprop-7 Online 6 10:30 A.M.-12:30 P.M.
October 8 Investiprop-7 On-site workshop 6 1:00 P.M.-4:00 P.M.
October 10 Slate Books Pro On-site workshop 4 9:00 A.M.-11:00 A.M.
October 13 Investiprop-7 Online 6 2:00 P.M.-4:00 P.M.

============================================

To: William Monahan
From: Tabitha Foster
Date: September 19
Subject: RE: Upcoming software training
Dear Mr. Monahan,
I am required to undergo training for both software programs, but I'm afraid I have some scheduling conflicts. I have already been approved to take my annual vacation from October 1 to October 7. I'll also be in Dallas from October 10 to 14 for the National Realtors Convention. Please call me at extension 21 so we can talk about how to resolve this issue.
Thanks!
Tabitha Foster

options: (A) It can track customer billing information.
(B) It is intended to replace another program.
(C) It has recently changed some of its features.
(D) It requires an account and password.
correctOptions: (B) It is intended to replace another program.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the first passage: "Investiprop-7 must be installed on all company computers, and we will start using it for all property searches instead of the EstateMax program."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email của William Monahan, ông đề cập rằng Investiprop-7 sẽ thay thế chương trình EstateMax cho tất cả các tìm kiếm tài sản: Investiprop-7 must be installed on all company computers, and we will start using it for all property searches instead of the EstateMax program. Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) It is intended to replace another program.

childQuestions.questionText: What is the same about all Investiprop-7 training sessions?
options: (A) They are all held on the Internet.
(B) They last for the same amount of time.
(C) They all take place in the morning.
(D) They have the same number of modules.
correctOptions: (D) They have the same number of modules.
childQuestions.transcript: Look at the Valley Realty Training Schedule, we can see that all Investiprop-7 training sessions have the same number of modules (which is 6)
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong lịch trình đào tạo của Valley Realty, tất cả các buổi đào tạo Investiprop-7 đều có 6 modules: "Number of Modules: 6." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (D) They have the same number of modules.

childQuestions.questionText: What is implied about Ms. Foster?
options: (A) She plans to transfer to the Dallas branch.
(B) She is a newly hired employee.
(D) She had difficulty installing the software.
childQuestions.transcript:
In the third passage, there is information "I am required to undergo training for both software programs"

Meanwhile, from the first passage, we can know that only accountants need to take two software program (Only accountants need to take the Slate Books Pro training)

=> C is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email của Tabitha Foster, cô ấy đề cập rằng cô ấy cần phải tham gia đào tạo cho cả hai phần mềm: “I am required to undergo training for both software programs”. Trong đó Slate Books Pro chỉ dành cho nhân viên kế toán: "Only accountants need to take the Slate Books Pro training." Do đó, có thể suy ra rằng cô ấy là một nhân viên kế toán. Vậy nên, đáp án đúng là (C) She works as an accountant.

childQuestions.questionText: When will Ms. Foster most likely undergo training?
childQuestions.transcript:
Information is in the third passage:

"I have already been approved to take my annual vacation from October 1 to October 7." => Eliminate A

"I'll also be in Dallas from October 10 to 14 for the National Realtors Convention." => Eliminate C,D

=> B is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Tabitha Foster có kỳ nghỉ từ ngày 1 đến ngày 7 tháng 10 “I have already been approved to take my annual vacation from October 1 to October 7.” và sẽ ở Dallas từ ngày 10 đến ngày 14 tháng 10: “I'll also be in Dallas from October 10 to 14 for the National Realtors Convention.” Ngày duy nhất phù hợp cho cô ấy tham gia đào tạo là ngày 8 tháng 10. Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) On October 8.

childQuestions.questionText: Why is Mr. Monahan asked to call Ms. Foster?
options: (B) To discuss solutions to a problem
(C) To confirm attendance at a convention
correctOptions: (B) To discuss solutions to a problem
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the third passage: "Please call me at extension 21 so we can talk about how to resolve this issue."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Tabitha Foster yêu cầu William Monahan gọi cô ấy để thảo luận về cách giải quyết vấn đề lịch trình của cô ấy: "Please call me at extension 21 so we can talk about how to resolve this issue." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) To discuss solutions to a problem.

refer to the following Web page, order form, and e-mail.
Hampstead
For the past twenty years, Hampstead has been supplying landscaping materials and equipment in the Culver City area. We're open annually from early spring to mid-fall, and we can help you create the outdoor space of your dreams whether you are shopping for your business or your family home.
We work hard to provide affordable goods, with a wide range of options to suit all tastes and budgets. We try to source our goods from businesses in and around Culver City whenever possible, as this supports the local economy and reduces pollution caused by transportation. In addition to our product line, we also offer
- Free local delivery on all orders exceeding $35
- Garden design services (whether ornamental or for crops)
- Fast and easy ordering by phone or online
- Referrals for landscaping professionals in your area
We accept returns for any reason within 30 days of the delivery date. Bagged items such as soil and wood chips must be unopened. If you receive damaged goods or the wrong item, we will reimburse you for the return shipping costs. Otherwise, you must cover those costs yourself.

To: Ray Casper <r.casper@lomaxitd.com>

From: Mara Brewer <m.brewer@lomaxltd.com>

Date: June 2

Subject:Landscaping

Hi Ray,

Thanks for ordering the materials that the maintenance team needs for the landscaping work in front of our building. I've used goods from a variety of stores, and these items from Hampstead are by far the best I've seen. I'm sure they will last for a long time. We are making steady progress on the changes, but we're running low on rocks, so I've ordered more of those. Also, one of the garden beds had a crack in it when it arrived, so we should exchange it. It would be best for you to contact Hampstead about that, since you placed the original order.

options: (A) It has branches in several cities.
(C) It is operated by a family.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information in the first passage: "We're open annually from early spring to mid-fall"

=> Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong phần mô tả của Hampstead, có đề cập rằng cửa hàng mở cửa hàng năm từ đầu xuân đến giữa mùa thu: "We're open annually from early spring to mid-fall." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (D) It is a seasonal business.

childQuestions.questionText: Which aspect of Hampstead is mentioned on the Web page?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the first passage: "We try to source our goods from businesses in and around Culver City whenever possible, as this supports the local economy and reduces pollution caused by transportation."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin có thể được suy ra từ: “We try to source our goods from businesses in and around Culver City whenever possible, as this supports the local economy and reduces pollution caused by transportation.”
(Chúng tôi cố gắng lấy nguồn hàng từ các doanh nghiệp trong và xung quanh Thành phố Culver bất cứ khi nào có thể, vì điều này hỗ trợ nền kinh tế địa phương và giảm ô nhiễm do giao thông vận tải gây ra.)
Thông tin cho thấy họ cố gắng tìm nguồn hàng từ các doanh nghiệp trong và xung quanh Culver City. Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) Supporting local businesses.

childQuestions.questionText: What does Ms. Brewer like about Hampstead?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the third passage: "I've used goods from a variety of stores, and these items from Hampstead are by far the best I've seen."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Thông tin: “I've used goods from a variety of stores, and these items from Hampstead are by far the best I've seen.”
(Tôi đã sử dụng hàng hóa từ nhiều cửa hàng khác nhau và những mặt hàng này từ Hampstead cho đến nay là những mặt hàng tốt nhất mà tôi từng thấy.)
Ms. Brewer khen ngợi các mặt hàng từ Hampstead là những mặt hàng tốt nhất mà cô ấy đã từng thấy. Do đó, đáp án đúng là (C) It has high-quality goods.

childQuestions.questionText: Which product has Ms. Brewer ordered?
childQuestions.transcript:
In the third passage, there is information "we're running low on rocks, so I've ordered more of those."

Look at the second passage, we can see information "Grey stones (20-Ib bag)" with the product ID of PS024.

=> D is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email của Ms. Brewer, cô ấy đề cập rằng họ đã hết đá và cô ấy đã đặt thêm: "we're running low on rocks, so I've ordered more of those." Mã sản phẩm cho đá là PS024. Do đó, đáp án đúng là (D) PS024.

childQuestions.questionText: How will Hampstead most likely respond to Mr. Casper's request?
options: (C) By issuing a full refund for a product
childQuestions.transcript:
In the third passage, there is information "Also, one of the garden beds had a crack in it when it arrived, so we should exchange it."

In the first passage, it says that "If you receive damaged goods or the wrong item, we will reimburse you for the return shipping costs."

=> D is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Theo chính sách của Hampstead, nếu khách hàng nhận được hàng bị hư hỏng hoặc sai, họ sẽ hoàn trả chi phí vận chuyển trả lại: “If you receive damaged goods or the wrong item, we will reimburse you for the return shipping costs.”. Vì một trong những giường vườn bị nứt khi nhận hàng, Hampstead sẽ hoàn trả chi phí vận chuyển trả lại. “Also, one of the garden beds had a crack in it when it arrived, so we should exchange it.” Do đó, đáp án đúng là (D) By reimbursing shipping costs.

cards.questionText:
refer to the following advertisement, form, and e-mail.
Bryson Camping Spring Sale
Stock up on essential goods at our Spring Sale. One week only - April 2-8.

- All Kolbert sleeping bags $29.99 each

- $10 off all Hathaway flashlights

- $60 off select outdoor stoves

- $15 off all Forestlife backpacks

- $30 off all Benson 2- and 3-person tents

Coupons cannot be used with certain sale prices.
Check our Web site for details.
============================================
Bryson Camping
Customer Inquiry/Comment Form
Customer Name: Rachel Barry
Company Name (if applicable): Adventure Tours
E-mail Address: rachelb@adventuretoursltd.net
Loyalty Card Number (if applicable): 7625003
File Upload: receipt.jpg
Inquiry/Comment: I recently purchased a large order of supplies for our customers' overnight camping trips. This included 5 Renway sleeping bags, 20 Hathaway flashlights, 8 Benson tents (the 3-person size), and 3 Forestlife backpacks. I saw on your Web site that most of these items are now being offered at discounted prices because of your Spring Sale. I have uploaded a copy of my receipt for review. I hope you will apply your 30-day price match to my order so that I can take advantage of the discount.
============================================

To: Rachel Barry <rachelb@ adventuretoursitd.net>
From: Bryson Camping <inquiries@ brysoncamping.com>
Date: April 4
Subject: Bryson Camping Customer Inquiry/Comment
Dear Ms. Barry,
Thank you for contacting Bryson Camping. You are correct that we refund the difference if the price drops within 30 days of the purchase date. However, some of the sale prices are not as low as what you have already received. For example, you got half off the Benson tents because the product was first offered at an introductory rate, as it was new to the market. You also received a bulk discount on items that were ordered in groups of ten or more. Therefore, you will only receive a partial refund for the Forestlife products. It will be sent along with a new receipt for those items within five business days.
We would love to know what you think about our inquiry process via the attached survey. If you send it back, you will be entered into a prize drawing for a $50 store voucher.
Justin Dugan
Customer Service Agent, Bryson Camping

childQuestions.questionText: What is implied about Ms. Barry?
options: (A) She was recently hired as a tour guide.
(B) She was misinformed about a store policy.
(C) She made a purchase before April 2.
(D) She visited the store 30 days ago.
correctOptions: (C) She made a purchase before April 2.
childQuestions.transcript:
In the second passage, there is information: "I saw on your Web site that most of these items are now being offered at discounted prices because of your Spring Sale. I have uploaded a copy of my receipt for review. I hope you will apply your 30-day price match to my order so that I can take advantage of the discount."

Meanwhile, in the first passage, it says that "Stock up on essential goods at our Spring Sale. One week only - April 2-8."

=> It can be inferred that Ms. Barry bought the items before April 2 and therefore was not eligible for discount.
childQuestions.explanationVi: Ms. Barry yêu cầu áp dụng chính sách giảm giá trong vòng 30 ngày cho các sản phẩm mà cô đã mua trước khi đợt giảm giá bắt đầu: "I hope you will apply your 30-day price match to my order so that I can take advantage of the discount." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) To process a request for a price change.

childQuestions.questionText: Why does Ms. Barry want the business to review a receipt?
options: (A) To issue a refund for damaged items
(B) To process a request for a price change
(C) To confirm that some items were not shipped
(D) To check whether an employee made an error
correctOptions: (B) To process a request for a price change
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information in the second passage: "I hope you will apply your 30-day price match to my order so that I can take advantage of the discount."

=> Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email của Mr. Dugan, ông đề cập rằng Ms. Barry đã nhận được giảm giá một nửa giá cho các lều Benson vì sản phẩm này được cung cấp lần đầu tiên với mức giá giới thiệu: "you got half off the Benson tents because the product was first offered at an introductory rate, as it was new to the market." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (B) She took advantage of a product launch.

childQuestions.questionText: According to Mr. Dugan, why was Ms. Barry given a discount on the Benson items?
options: (A) She signed up for a loyalty club program.
(B) She took advantage of a product launch.
(C) She purchased a large number of goods.
correctOptions: (B) She took advantage of a product launch.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the third passage: "you got half off the Benson tents because the product was first offered at an introductory rate, as it was new to the market."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong email của Mr. Dugan, ông đề cập rằng Ms. Barry sẽ chỉ nhận được một phần hoàn lại cho các sản phẩm của Forestlife (ba lô) và sẽ nhận được một biên lai mới cho những mặt hàng đó: "Therefore, you will only receive a partial refund for the Forestlife products. It will be sent along with a new receipt for those items within five business days." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (A) Backpacks.

childQuestions.questionText: For which items will Ms. Barry receive a new receipt?
childQuestions.transcript:
In the third passage, there is information "Therefore, you will only receive a partial refund for the Forestlife products. It will be sent along with a new receipt for those items within five business days."

Look at the first passage, we can see that the Forestlife products are backpacks ($15 off all Forestlife backpacks)

=> A is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Mr. Dugan đề cập rằng một khảo sát đã được đính kèm theo email và mời Ms. Barry gửi lại để tham gia vào cuộc rút thăm trúng thưởng: "We would love to know what you think about our inquiry process via the attached survey." Do đó, đáp án đúng là (D) A feedback form.

childQuestions.questionText: What has Mr. Dugan sent with the e-mail?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in the third passage: "We would love to know what you think about our inquiry process via the attached survey."
childQuestions.explanationVi: Thông tin ở trong đoạn 3: "We would love to know what you think about our inquiry process via the attached survey."
